about: Ski-season metrics from NRCS SNOTEL daily data near Snoqualmie Pass, with NOAA ENSO (ONI) and PDO indices and NLDAS-2 temperature. q = Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all trends in this file.
sensor_caveat: SNOTEL temperature sensors were replaced across the western US around 2005-2013, which adds an artificial warm jump (Oyler et al. 2015). Treat SNOTEL temperature trends with caution; compare with the NLDAS temperature in nldas_temperature.
